paragraphs: Honorlock proctors online exams, pairing software monitoring with review by people. For schools and colleges it sits inside the learning system students already use. The same service is sold to employers for hiring and workforce compliance.

The software monitors each exam session and alerts a live proctor when it detects a potential problem. That proctor can enter the session and help the student get back on track rather than simply recording a flag. A separate service looks for exam questions posted online and gets them removed.

Honorlock says it began with two students at Florida Atlantic University who set out to level the playing field for online assessments. It reports nearly 200 employees serving more than 300 educational institutions, plus corporations. The company states that it does not sell student data to third parties. It also says it is SOC 2 Type 2 certified.

quote.text: Honorlock combines AI-powered monitoring with real human review to protect fair testing while treating students and candidates with empathy and respect.
